newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BAe unit wins Kuwait vehicle order.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BAe unit wins Kuwait vehicle order.

text.p: British Aerospace Australia said on Monday it had secured the sale of 22 Shorland S-600 series armoured personnel vehicles to the Kuwait National Guard.

The order, which includes training and support, follows the purchase last year by British Aerospace's Australian unit of the armoured vehicle division of Short Brothers, Northern Ireland, it said in a statement.
The statement did not give a value to the Kuwait deal, but local media said it was believed to be worth A$20 million.
British Aerospace Australian said the vehicles would be manufactured in Australia, where British Aerospace already had two large contracts to build military vehicles for the Australian army.
British Aerospace Australia's head of international marketing Tony Ennis said the company was aiming in 1997 to achieve at least the A$110 million in export contracts achieved in 1996.
